title: 6% Polyacrylamide Gel (TBE system)
author: Md Jubayer Alam
materials: Stir gently until the mixture is homogeneous.
Visualise the gel under a UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Prepare acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 29 g acrylamide and 1 g bis‑acrylamide in ~60 mL distilled water, then add water to a final volume of 100 mL; store at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Prepare APS stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.033 g ammonium persulfate (APS) in 330 µL distilled water; store at 4 °C and prepare fresh weekly.

steps.title: Mix gel components
steps.instruction: In a clean glass beaker combine 12 mL distilled water, 4 mL 30 % polyacrylamide solution, and 4 mL 5× TBE buffer; stir gently until homogeneous.

steps.title: Add APS and TEMED
steps.instruction: While stirring, add 330 µL of the 10 % APS solution, then immediately add 16.7 µL TEMED and mix quickly; note that APS and TEMED are highly reactive and should be added seconds before pouring.

steps.title: Cast and polymerise gel
steps.instruction: Immediately pour the gel solution between the glass plates, insert the comb carefully, allow polymerisation at room temperature for 30–35 min, then remove the comb and rinse wells gently with buffer using a pipette to eliminate trapped air bubbles.

steps.title: Pre‑run and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Pre‑run the gel in 1× TBE at 120 V for 5 min, load samples into wells, then run at 120 V until the dye front reaches the bottom or runs off (≈50–55 min).

steps.title: Stain and visualise gel
steps.instruction: Stain the gel in 0.5 % ethidium bromide solution for 15 min, rinse briefly with distilled water to enhance contrast, and visualise under a UV transilluminator.
